picture.description: NASA rendering of a Kilopower fission power unit on the surface of the Moon (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/kilopower_moon_render_1_1.jpg, shown on NASA's Kilopower page with the text "Rendering of Kilopower on surface of the moon"); before sending, the picture was cropped to the unit and everything outside it painted white

simplifications: The picture shows a Kilopower unit, the smaller NASA design that came before the 40 kWe fission surface power goal; it stands in for the 40 kWe unit (catalog item fsp_40kwe).
The picture shows the unit from one side, nearly edge-on to the radiator, so the generator guessed the radiator's round shape, the far side and the back.
The radiator is one thin sheet with some small holes, and the thin rods of the mast are rough.
No size is published for this rendering: the 6.0 m height is our estimate, and the radiator's width is measured from the shape scaled to it.
All colours, textures and markings removed; one plain grey material.

finishing.material: one neutral material; every texture, image, UV coordinate, per-vertex colour and original material removed
